subject: science
concept: Identifying basic landforms and bodies of water (mountain, valley, river, lake, ocean)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds simple landform shapes using virtual modeling materials and names them
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a pictured landform or water body to its correct name
exercise.abstract: Student describes a landform or body of water from a written definition

misconception_flags: confuses similar landforms (hill vs. mountain, lake vs. ocean) based on size alone

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
